reason: Our system has worked for years and the vendor knows us; members already book and pay through GOLF.NL for free. For a 9-hole club run by volunteers, adding roughly 270 to 360 euros a month for a nicer app is hard to sell to the members' meeting when the real complaint is just finding the booking link on the phone.
objection: Two founders and a brand-new product. Even with escrow and exports, I don't want our volunteers to be the guinea pigs, and I can't justify a new monthly cost to fix something a home-screen shortcut could fix.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a club our size, not Zwolle, live for a full season with older members actually using it, and the total cost coming out at or below what we pay our current vendor.
